    • showToast

      public void showToast(String text, ToastType type)
      Displays a toast message with the given text and type. The toast fades in, remains visible for a short duration, and then fades out before being removed from the user interface.
      Parameters:
      text - the text content to be displayed in the toast message
      type - the ToastType indicating the style or category of the toast

    • getTransition

      private javafx.animation.SequentialTransition getTransition(javafx.scene.layout.HBox errorBox)
      Creates a sequential transition that applies a fade-in effect, a pause, and a fade-out effect to the specified error box. Once the fade-out is complete, the error box is removed from the root pane.
      Parameters:
      errorBox - the HBox instance representing the error box to which the transitions will be applied
      Returns:
      a SequentialTransition consisting of a fade-in, pause, and fade-out animation on the given error box

    • setVisibility

      protected <T extends javafx.scene.Node> void setVisibility(T node, boolean visible)
      Sets the visibility and managed state of a given JavaFX Node.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the JavaFX Node, which extends Node
      Parameters:
      node - the Node whose visibility is to be set
      visible - true to make the Node visible and managed, false to make it invisible and unmanaged
